data.name: Coming Attraction
data.oracle_text: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Open an Attraction. (Put the top card of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield.)
data.flavor_text: The Astrotorium adds new attractions almost as fast as Captain Nebula can crash them into asteroids.

data.name: Command Performance
data.oracle_text:
Choose two —
• Open an Attraction. (Put the top card of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield.)
• Roll to visit your Attractions.
• You get {TK}{TK}.
• You may put a sticker on a nonland permanent you own.

data.name: Complaints Clerk
data.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, open an Attraction. (Put the top card of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield.)
Whenever you roll a 1, create a 1/1 white Clown Robot artifact creature token.
data.flavor_text: The longest lines in the park.

data.name: Cover the Spot
data.oracle_text:
Visit — Drop three cards you own from outside the game one at a time onto the playing area from a height of at least one foot (about 0.3 meters). If those cards completely cover this Attraction, claim the prize!
Prize — You get {TK}{TK}{TK}{TK}, then you may put a sticker on a nonland permanent you own. Sacrifice this Attraction, then open an Attraction.

data.name: Dart Throw
data.oracle_text:
Visit — Throw a card you own from outside the game onto the playing area from a distance of three feet (about one meter). If that card touches this Attraction, claim the prize!
Prize — Create two 2/2 pink Teddy Bear creature tokens. Sacrifice this Attraction, then open an Attraction.

data.name: Deadbeat Attendant
data.oracle_text: When this creature enters, open an Attraction. (Put the top card of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield.)
data.flavor_text: Some people will hire anyone with a pulse. Myra isn't that picky.

data.name: Dee Kay, Finder of the Lost
data.oracle_text:
When Dee Kay enters, open an Attraction.
Whenever you roll a 2, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Whenever you roll a 4, you may tap or untap target artifact or creature.
Whenever you roll a 6, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

data.name: Discourtesy Clerk
data.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, open an Attraction. (Put the top card of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield.)
At the beginning of your end step, if you control three or more Attractions, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
data.flavor_text: Myra doesn't pay the vampires to smile—but only because guests found it off-putting.

data.name: Draconian Gate-Bot
data.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, choose one —
• Open an Attraction. (Put the top card of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield.)
• Destroy target Attraction. (It's put into its owner's junkyard.)
data.flavor_text: "YOU MUST BE THIS TALL TO RIDE. YOU HAVE TEN SECONDS TO COMPLY."

data.name: Goblin Blastronauts
data.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, open an Attraction.
Whenever you roll a 6, you may copy the spell, ability, or Attraction visit that caused you to roll that die. You may choose new targets for the copy.
data.flavor_text: The goblins really put themselves into the fireworks show, despite Myra's pleas to stop.

data.name: Guess Your Fate
data.oracle_text:
Visit — Look at the bottom card of your library, then give a person outside the game a one-word clue not on that card. They guess a word. If their guess appears in that card's name, claim the prize!
Prize — Reveal the card, put it into your hand, then sacrifice this Attraction and open an Attraction.

data.name: "Lifetime" Pass Holder
data.oracle_text:
This creature enters tapped.
When this creature dies, open an Attraction.
Whenever you roll to visit your Attractions, if you roll a 6, you may return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

data.name: Memory Test
data.oracle_text:
When this Attraction enters, target opponent exiles cards from the bottom of their library until they exile five nonland cards, then turns those nonland cards face down.
Visit — Name the exiled face-down cards, then look at them. If you named them correctly, turn them face up, then claim the prize!
Prize — Create three 1/1 red Balloon creature tokens with flying, then sacrifice this Attraction and open an Attraction.

data.name: Monitor Monitor
data.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, open an Attraction. (Put the top card of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield.)
Once each turn, you may pay {1} to reroll one or more dice you rolled.
data.flavor_text: Nine fires, a hull breach, and a Quafloovian meganibbler escaped from the petting zoo. Things were suspiciously quiet.

data.name: Myra the Magnificent
data.oracle_text:
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand, open an Attraction.
{X}, {T}: Exile target instant or sorcery card with mana value X from your graveyard and choose an Attraction you control that doesn't have a midway counter on it. Put a midway counter on it. For as long as that Attraction is on the battlefield, whenever you visit it, copy the exiled card. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.

data.name: Petting Zookeeper
data.oracle_text:
Reach
When this creature enters, open an Attraction. (Put the top card of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield.)
data.flavor_text: Calling it a "petting zoo" really saved on the cages.

data.name: Pick-a-Beeble
data.oracle_text:
Visit — Roll a six-sided die. Put a number of luck counters on Pick-a-Beeble equal to the result and create a Treasure token. Then if there are six or more luck counters on Pick-a-Beeble, claim the prize!
Prize — Create two Treasure tokens, then sacrifice Pick-a-Beeble and open an Attraction.

data.name: Push Your Luck
data.oracle_text:
Visit — Reveal cards from the top of your library until you decide to stop. If the total mana value of the cards revealed this way is 7 or less, create a 2/2 pink Teddy Bear creature token. If the total is exactly 7, claim the prize Shuffle the revealed cards into your library.
Prize — Put five +1/+1 counters on a Teddy Bear you control. It gains haste. Sacrifice this Attraction and open an Attraction.

data.name: Quick Fixer
data.oracle_text:
Menace
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, open an Attraction. (Put the top card of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield.)
data.flavor_text: Myra doesn't believe in stopping rides for minor inconveniences like "they need to be repaired."

data.name: Rad Rascal
data.oracle_text: When this creature enters, open an Attraction. (Put the top card of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield.)
data.flavor_text: "Rent a scooter and be just like Devil K. Nevil! Just don't go faster than the speed limit. Or jump over anything. Or catch on fire. Or break every bone in your body multiple times. Other than that, just like him!"

data.name: Ride Guide
data.oracle_text: When this creature enters, open an Attraction. (Put the top card of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield.)
data.flavor_text: "When riding Erebos's Whip, remember to keep your arms, legs, and any strange flailing appendages inside the vehicle at all times."

As long as you've visited an Attraction this turn, this creature has indestructible. (Damage and effects that say "destroy" don't destroy it.)
When this creature enters, open an Attraction. (Put the top card of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield.)

data.name: Spinnerette, Arachnobat
data.oracle_text:
Reach
When Spinnerette enters, open an Attraction.
As long as you control three or more Attractions, Spinnerette gets +2/+0 and has menace.
data.flavor_text: High-wire injuries are down 95%. Spider-related injuries are up 3000%.

data.name: Squirrel Squatters
data.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, open an Attraction. (Put the top card of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield.)
Whenever this creature attacks, create a 1/1 green Squirrel creature token that's tapped and attacking for each Attraction you've visited this turn.

data.name: Squirrel Stack
data.oracle_text:
Visit — You have five seconds to stack dice on top of one another. If you stack at least five dice, claim the prize
Prize — Create a 1/1 green Squirrel creature token for each die you stacked above the fourth, then sacrifice this Attraction and open an Attraction.

data.name: Step Right Up
data.oracle_text: Open two Attractions. (Put the top two cards of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield.)
data.flavor_text:
"Ah, the midway, beating heart of the—well, maybe the big top is the heart. If there were two hearts, then the midway—or the lungs. Lungs or stomach!"
—Captain Rex Nebula

data.name: The Most Dangerous Gamer

Whenever The Most Dangerous Gamer enters or attacks, open an Attraction.
Whenever you open an Attraction, put a +1/+1 counter on The Most Dangerous Gamer.
